module.name: Network Attachment Definitions
module.description: Creates Multus NetworkAttachmentDefinitions for TMM external and internal data-plane networks.

required.reason: NADs deployed to operator namespace created by prerequisites

required.name: namespace
required.description: Namespace for NADs (must match CNEInstance namespace)

required.name: external_subnet_cidrs
required.description: External subnet CIDRs for IPAM ranges

required.name: internal_subnet_cidrs
required.description: Internal subnet CIDRs for IPAM ranges

optional.name: tmm_data_plane_mode
optional.description: TMM data-plane mode: 'kernel' (default, host-device CNI) or 'sriov' (legacy DPDK/vfio-pci). Must match infra/aws/high-performance-nodes.tmm_data_plane_mode and bnk/cneinstance.tmm_data_plane_mode.

optional.name: external_pci_bus_id
optional.description: (kernel mode) PCI bus ID of the external SR-IOV ENI (device 2 by default per high-performance-nodes module).

optional.name: internal_pci_bus_id
optional.description: (kernel mode) PCI bus ID of the internal SR-IOV ENI (device 1 by default per high-performance-nodes module).

optional.name: cni_type
optional.description: (sriov mode only) CNI plugin type — 'host-device' (kernel mode default) or 'sriov'/'vfio' (legacy)

optional.name: external_resource_name
optional.description: (sriov mode only) SR-IOV device plugin resource name for external network

optional.name: internal_resource_name
optional.description: (sriov mode only) SR-IOV device plugin resource name for internal network

optional.name: external_nad_name
optional.description: Name for external NAD (default: external-netdevice, DPU: sf-external)

optional.name: internal_nad_name
optional.description: Name for internal NAD (default: internal-netdevice, DPU: sf-internal)

key_outputs.name: tmm_data_plane_mode
key_outputs.description: TMM data-plane mode this module deployed (kernel|sriov). Wire to bnk/cneinstance.tmm_data_plane_mode for consistency.

key_outputs.name: external_pci_bus_id
key_outputs.description: PCI bus ID of the external ENI (e.g. 0000:00:07.0). Wire to bnk/cneinstance.external_pci_bus_id.

key_outputs.name: internal_pci_bus_id
key_outputs.description: PCI bus ID of the internal ENI (e.g. 0000:00:08.0). Wire to bnk/cneinstance.internal_pci_bus_id.
